answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Attested organic certification record with organic body attestation. It requires a certification the body renews after annual inspections, so the glacier of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. A farm doing the maths finds the echo first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The trellis is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
